_comment: Illustration de l'app iOS pour l'entrée « Parcours » de l'onglet Explorer, direction affiche (mêmes réglages que manifest-app-progress.json), en deux couleurs : marine et safran sur papier crème. Sortie convertie en JPEG 1200 × 900 dans ios/Sophia/Assets.xcassets/path_poster.imageset.

items.name: path_poster
items.prompt: On a plain cream paper background: a winding deep navy blue path that snakes up a gentle saffron yellow hill, marked by five round stepping-stone milestones with small flags, leading to a big saffron shining star at the top; a small simple navy figure with a backpack walks on the path. The sky is empty cream paper, no blue sky. Flat poster illustration, linocut paper-cut shapes, strictly two colors: deep navy blue and saffron yellow on a cream paper background, bold simple forms, subtle paper grain, airy composition, no text, no letters, no numbers, no outlines.
